title: Vapor Generator
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.418TH CSB.W6QM MICC-DUGWAY PROV GRD
description_text: The Applied Science Division at Dugway Proving Ground (DPG) is partnering with the University of Notre Dame (NDSI) under a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA), funded by a SMART SEED Innovation Award. The goal of this partnership is to evaluate and validate novel electronic vapor sensors for the detection of chemical warfare agents.
